name: ChartPNG: Google Sheets chart to Telegram

parameters.content:
### How it works
Every Monday at 09:00 this workflow reads a Google Sheet and sends it to a Telegram chat as a bar chart. Google Sheets has no API that exports its own charts, so the workflow builds the chart from the rows instead: ChartPNG (chartpng.dev) draws a PNG from a Chart.js config in the image URL, and Telegram receives that URL in the Photo field. No file is uploaded and no binary data is passed.

**Check the render** opens the URL once before anything is sent, so a sheet with a missing or non-numeric value stops the run with a message that names the row, instead of sending a broken image. A Slack branch is included, disabled.

### Setup
1. Make a tab with two headers: `label` (the bar names) and `value` (numbers).
2. In **Settings**, set `spreadsheetId` (the long ID in the sheet's URL), `sheetName`, `chartTitle` and `telegramChatId`.
3. Select your Google Sheets credential in **Read rows** and your Telegram bot credential in **Send photo to Telegram**. Message the bot once from the chat first.
4. Run the workflow once, check the photo in Telegram, then activate it.

### Customization
To also post to Slack, enable **Post to Slack**, select a Slack credential and set `slackChannelId`. Slack takes image URLs up to 3000 characters; over that, only the Slack node stops. Without a ChartPNG key the image carries a small watermark; a signed URL removes it: https://chartpng.dev/docs#signed-urls. Guide: https://chartpng.dev/guides/google-sheets-chart-to-telegram

## When and which sheet
Runs every Monday at 09:00 in the workflow timezone. **Settings** holds the sheet, the title and where the chart goes.

## Read the sheet
One item per row of the tab, with its `label` and `value` columns.

## Build and check the chart
Turns the rows into a ChartPNG image URL and opens it once, so a bad row stops the run before anything is sent.

## Send the chart
Telegram gets the image URL as a photo with a caption. The Slack branch is off until you enable it.
